nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: I watched the WHOLE escape from the roof. The water tower! The wagon! You didn't even LOOK at the second shot. I'm telling everyone you didn't look.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: Too late. The legend is already forming. Legends don't look.

nodes.speaker: Newt
nodes.text: The whole time! Three owl hoots, danger-west. You... heard them, right? The hoots?

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: I heard something lose an argument with a harmonica.
